recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source edit is needed for FHIR-4004 unless a future work group decision independently reopens the question of allowing Range on NutritionOrder.oralDiet.nutrient.amount.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request from the DSTU1 ballot asking to simplify NutritionOrder.item.oralDiet.nutrients.amount[x] by removing Range and leaving Quantity, because Quantity still supports comparator-style restrictions such as less than 2 gm sodium.
initial_application: No explicit git commit message names FHIR-4004, but historical commit 7d67ca802e5a4a4a472dcba2a975d3e1b6b9a230 changed the NutritionOrder spreadsheet shortly after the 2015-01-19 vote from an amount[x] Quantity|Range choice to a Quantity-only amount row. The current StructureDefinition preserves a committee note: "2/4/2015 EH: [#4004] remove choice from .nutient.amount."
additional_context: NutritionOrder is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to OO. Later source migrations renamed and normalized the path to NutritionOrder.oralDiet.nutrient.amount, but preserved the Quantity-only type. FHIR-5165 is a broader Quantity-comparator discussion that mentioned this element but did not supersede FHIR-4004 or require restoring Range. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current active source/nutritionorder/structuredefinition-NutritionOrder.xml already gives NutritionOrder.oralDiet.nutrient.amount cardinality 0..1 and a single type, Quantity; source searches found no amountRange, Quantity|Range, or amount[x] Range choice remaining in NutritionOrder.

related_jiras.note: Broader Published Quantity comparator issue whose comments mention NutritionOrder.oralDiet.nutrient.amount, while its final resolution leaves other Quantity references as Quantity; it does not supersede FHIR-4004.
